correctness.rationale: Independent exhaustive mask enumeration of all 2^12 vertex subsets found 20 forbidden triangular cliques, 1048 augmented faces and f=(12,66,200,345,312,112). The pivot matching of 523 valid face-cover pairs (including matched empty face), in given 12-pivot order, leaves exactly mask213 four-cell and mask3147 five-cell; independent full Hasse DAG topological sort visited all 1048 faces, establishing acyclicity. Recursing signed integer elimination for four-faces against the unique five critical face gave EXACT Morse boundary -2, not merely a mod2 rank pattern. Ordinary Morse CW model has one basepoint, one 4-cell and one 5-cell attached degree ±2; maps S4->S4 classified by degree, so homotopy is Moore M(Z/2,4)=Sigma^3 RP2; reduced H4=Z/2 and no other reduced homology. Independent checks of integer recurrence and mod2/mod3 consistency do not assume rational homology detects torsion.
